newsitem.title: USA: DSC to buy TI's telecom systems.
newsitem.headline: DSC to buy TI's telecom systems.

text.p: DSC Communications Corp said Wednesday that it has agreed to buy for cash the Telecommunications Systems Division business of Texas Instruments Inc.

Texas Instruments telecommunications systems division was founded in the late 1980s and provides voice-enabled services. Its products include voice-dialing services, voice-activated network control and facsimile messaging services.
DSC said it will merge the business with its switching systems group. It said it expects to close the deal by mid-June.

DSC said the acquisition involves about 100 Austin and Dallas-based TI employees. It also includes a cooperative relationship between DSC and TI's Multimedia Technology Laboratory for speech recognition, DSC said.
DSC Communications provides advanced telecommunications products, including digital switching, transmission, access and network management systems. The company annual revenues of about $1.4 billion.
